properties.name: The open structural-defect list means still-needs-attention
properties.statement: A structural defect that has been reviewed and consciously accepted must move out of the open list into a reviewed one — not deleted, not hidden — the way an acknowledged gap already does. Found as friction 2026-07-25: detect_defects reports the same six findings every run, all six carrying recorded Decisions explaining why they stand, so a genuine seventh would arrive into a list nobody reads carefully and the count is the only signal. reviewed_gaps already keeps this promise for gaps on the stated grounds that "a list that can never reach zero gets skimmed"; the defect side makes the same promise in its docs and does not keep it. Two properties carried over from the gap side: the acceptance records WHY, as a real node that outlives the session, and it expires when the affected nodes change, so an accepted defect comes back for a fresh look rather than staying quietly accepted forever.
